resources.string: Search name, username, phone or label
Hold an account to edit its local label, color and pin.
Start a music track for this account first.

Tap a color to enter its hex value. Save replaces WGTG Custom and turns off automatic night mode. Export shares the colors without applying them. Bubble radius is a local setting and is not included in .attheme files.

Hold the emoji button beside the message field to choose bold, italic, monospace or spoiler for this chat, or turn autoformat off. Applies to new messages and captions; explicit formatting is preserved.
Could not apply the theme. Please try again.

Ten built-in palettes, from pure black to forest, plum, arctic and rose, with matching controls and message bubbles. Selecting a palette turns off automatic night mode. Use the theme builder to create your own colors.
Controls interface animations. The selected style applies to normal chat opening and closing; swipe gestures, previews and special transitions keep their own animations. Reduced motion is respected.

Choose how new messages appear. New styles replace the send morph; greeting stickers retain their special transition. Effects with scaling fall back to fade for albums and reduced performance settings. Interface animations must also be enabled.
Make unformatted parts of new messages and captions bold. Existing formatting, links, code and custom emoji are preserved. Retries and rich messages are unchanged.
Ghost mode: hide online and typing status
Choose chats, groups and channels as music sources. Your selection is saved on this device for this account. Tap a source to remove it from the playlist.
These options apply to all accounts on this device.
Make WGTG yours with app icons, extensions and music from your chats.
No sources yet. Add a chat to build your playlist.
Remove this source from the playlist? Messages and music in the chat will be kept.
Plays up to 100 music tracks from each source. Secret chats are not included.

Python 3.11 plugin engine. Supports .plugin, .py and Elyx ZIP archives with a subset of exteraGram hooks, menus and settings. Dependencies require compatible pure-Python wheels; conflicting libraries are rejected.
Plugins are executable code and receive the same Telegram data and permissions as wgtg. Install only code you trust. A malicious plugin can read messages or send requests as you.
Sender name colors in chats are only visible on this device. Chroma cycles the hue; RGB animates a rainbow. Names with bot attribution keep their original style.

For this account: saves cached incoming cloud messages when a remote deletion arrives, plus fully downloaded media. Open files with a compatible viewer. Secret chats and disappearing media are excluded. Previously deleted or unavailable content cannot be recovered. Copies remain until you clear the archive or log out.
